name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | Purple Punch
description: Get ready to feel the one-two punch of flavor and relaxation with Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Purple Punch. This hard-hitting indica is crafted from fresh-frozen cannabis, preserving its rich terpene profile and knockout potency for a smooth and flavorful dabbing experience. With sweet grape, blueberry, and vanilla pastry notes, Purple Punch delivers a fast-acting cerebral euphoria followed by deep, full-body relaxation. Perfect for winding down after a long day, relieving stress, or catching some serious Zs, this strain is an indica lover’s dream.
